scope: CalculiX2.23 bounded serial rectangular linear-elastic members: six signed end resultants, combined axial/biaxial bending/rectangular torsion, clamped or pure-axial sliding restraint, native measured translation/twist/interior normal and von Mises limits, independent theory/stress/refinement/equilibrium and exact saved-deck reopening. No arbitrary mesh/deck, nonrectangular section, general FEA, peak/yield/fatigue/stability, nonlinear/modal/thermal/contact or MPI claim.
acceptance: Run tools/qualify_calculix.py against stable2.23: all14 native cases, independent literal axial/biaxial/moment/torsion witnesses, square/wide/tall sections, sliding restraint, active-component refinement/theory/interior stress and force/moment checks, exact deck reopen, performance rejection/recovery, torque reversal, stiffness scaling, semantic/status/native shear tamper and lifecycle.
